response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS overall_mean FROM group_averages) SELECT g.ID AS patient_id, g.avg_ana, g.avg_ana - o.overall_mean AS excess FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.avg_ana > o.overall_mean ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
